title: Staff Training
description: You are the cat. Your staff are a human couple who mean well and have learned nothing. Work through the manual: breakfast at 5 AM, second breakfast, the laptop is a bed, doors are a suggestion, teach them to fetch, and take 70% of the bed.
controls: W/S walk, A/D turn, Space jump, Q meow, Shift zoomies, E mischief, F charm, Esc pause. Touch: joystick on the left (up walks, sideways turns), buttons on the right. Gamepad supported.
